title: DECISION: SMTP delivery fallback on unprovisioned INBOX
description: In sieve_delivery, if the INBOX mailbox row is not found in the JMAP DB for a user, the code logs a warning and falls back to writing the message to the legacy smtp store rather than silently dropping the message. This is defense-in-depth: mail is never lost due to a provisioning gap. The fallback is named and observable via the warning log line. Alternative rejected: fail closed with 452/550. Losing mail permanently is worse than storing it in a secondary location. Tradeoff: the fallback path is a different storage backend, so operators must check both stores during incident response.
